# Description of Changes

## Risk level: Low

This is a low risk change because it enhances the package while preserving existing behaviour. This includes internal refactors to the package's source code and new feature additions that do not touch existing features. It must pass the CI checks in order for changes to be merged and deployed.

## Type of Change

The type of changes made can be found on the labels associated with the pull request. The exact changes made can be found under the commits tab.
